QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] To the Base of the Mountain
QuestInfo.0: The village below the cliff is fully ablaze! You've got to get down there and help!
QuestInfo.1: The fire blazing across the village is so bad that you can even see it from your vantage point on the mountain. #eYou've got to hurry down there and help!#n
QuestInfo.2: The village is ablaze and the outskirts have become overrun with raging monsters. The villagers are in danger. Get there quickly!

0.conditionContent: Head down to the burning village!
